summary: Iteration 5 verification: QR scanning page, overdue notification popup w/ extend, invoice generation (PDF+send), QR label PDF, due_in_days on loans, bank_account/kid_prefix on clubs. Backend: 11/11 pytest cases pass. Frontend: all new testids and components render correctly; overdue popup auto-opens on login with Forleng flow, Forfall+Belastes columns present in loans table, loan-due-select present in new-loan dialog, edit-club-bank/edit-club-kid present in Rediger klubb dialog, team-invoice-btn present, Skann QR nav + /app/skann renders with start-scan-btn, qr-labels-btn present on inventory.

issues: Popup is forcibly modal (correct behavior per spec) and auto-opens before user can click 'Nytt utlån' - as intended. The Forfall column shows red date for overdue items - verified.

critical_code_review_comments: server.py reached 2142 lines - approaching maintainability threshold; consider splitting invoices, notifications, loans modules into separate routers.

_build_invoice_pdf uses customer_number + invoice_number for KID (line 1838). KID lacks a mod-10/11 check-digit. For real Norwegian KID numbers, consider adding a Luhn/MOD10 check-digit for bank compatibility.

invoice pdf_data stored as base64 string inside the invoice document (line 1853) - this inflates the primary document size unnecessarily. Consider GridFS or a separate pdf collection to keep /api/invoices list queries fast.
QR labels endpoint lacks pagination and reads up to 1000 items with QR image generation per request - may timeout on large inventories. Consider streaming or background job.
Notification endpoint iterates in Python to filter unseen (lines 1696-1699) - could be moved to a mongo aggregation for larger datasets.
seed_data_creation: Test module creates TEST_It5_* tenant via /api/signup, upgrades to deluxe, uses pymongo (async motor) to backdate loan due_date for overdue notification test. Teardown soft-deletes tenant.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 5 features all verified. Admin tenant 'Egen klubb' already had 1 overdue loan at startup causing automatic popup. Invoice send endpoint returns 200 (EMERGENT_EMAIL_KEY is set in backend/.env). KID = customer_number + invoice_number (no check-digit).
